english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for engaging in business or trading goods.
Use this when the dealings are commercial, including being in the business of trading a particular product.

examples.english: We’ve been in the trade for many years.
examples.traditional: 我哋做生意做咗好多年喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou6 saang1 ji3 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 laa3

examples.traditional: 佢哋專門做生意，賣日本茶。
